notes: Added missing core logic, integration, audit persistence, and admin access stories for consent workflow.

change_log.note: Adds missing core workflow logic story
Ensures cross-service integration with lead capture
Adds controlled access for consent review

FEAT-6-S126.title: Core Consent Service Logic Implementation
FEAT-6-S126.description: Implement two-tier consent logic including Tier 1 (de-identified usage) and Tier 2 (identified storage), enforcing valid transitions, triggering summarization, and applying HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification rules.

FEAT-6-S127.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture
FEAT-6-S127.description: Integrate ConsentService with LeadService to enforce Tier 2 requirement before storing identifiable lead data, including duplicate detection and consent validation gating.

FEAT-6-S128.title: Consent Audit Logging and Persistence
FEAT-6-S128.description: Persist consent decisions, tier changes, timestamps, and associated conversation summaries to MongoDB with audit logging support, ensuring traceability and compliance alignment.

FEAT-6-S129.title: Admin Consent Retrieval API
FEAT-6-S129.description: Expose secure backend endpoint(s) for retrieving consent records and audit trails for internal review, ensuring no violation of de-identification constraints for Tier 1 data.
